notes: The indicator library is just as long as the series catalog, so it gets the SAME presentation the 4.68.0 series picker got: backdrop, centered modal, search promoted to the header beside the ✕, Esc / backdrop-click to close. The rail-and-list layout it already had becomes the modal body and fills the shell instead of capping at a dropdown height. One shell, two long lists — the pattern is now the house style for any picker that outgrows a dropdown.
